build_bot_policy: build a bot policy by name from the meltingpot bot factory
build_bot_from_config: build a bot policy from a BotConfig object with model path and optional puppeteer
get_bot_config: get the BotConfig for a named bot from the meltingpot bot registry
get_bot_factory: get a PolicyFactory for a named bot including the noop bot
get_factory_from_config: get a PolicyFactory from a BotConfig using the substrate factory
